mapper.select: SELECT a.dataset_id,a.version,d.status,d.manifest_json AS manifest FROM dictionary_audio_active a LEFT JOIN dictionary_audio_dataset d ON d.id=a.dataset_id WHERE a.slot=1
SELECT dataset_id,version FROM dictionary_audio_active WHERE slot=1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM dictionary_audio_dataset WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE dictionary_audio_dataset SET lease_owner=#{owner},lease_until=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,120,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='IMPORTING' AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))

UPDATE dictionary_audio_dataset SET lease_until=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,120,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='IMPORTING' AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND lease_until>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
UPDATE dictionary_audio_dataset SET lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='IMPORTING' AND lease_owner=#{owner}

UPDATE dictionary_audio_dataset SET imported_assets=#{assets},imported_mappings=#{mappings},last_asset_ordinal=#{assets},last_mapping_ordinal=#{mappings},updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND lease_until>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND status='IMPORTING'

UPDATE dictionary_audio_dataset SET status='READY',lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND lease_until>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND status='IMPORTING'

UPDATE dictionary_audio_dataset SET status='FAILED',error_code='AUDIO_DATABASE_VERIFY_FAILED',lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND status='IMPORTING'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dictionary_audio_asset WHERE dataset_id=#{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dictionary_audio_mapping WHERE dataset_id=#{id}
SELECT source_ordinal,storage_key,bytes,output_sha FROM dictionary_audio_asset WHERE dataset_id=#{dataset} AND source_ordinal>#{after} ORDER BY source_ordinal LIMIT 500

SELECT a.id,a.output_sha,a.duration_ms,m.accent FROM dictionary_audio_mapping m JOIN dictionary_audio_asset a ON a.dataset_id=m.dataset_id AND a.id=m.audio_id WHERE m.dataset_id=#{dataset} AND m.word_key=#{word} ORDER BY m.accent,m.source_ordinal,m.link_order

SELECT a.id,a.dataset_id,a.storage_key,a.bytes,a.output_sha,a.duration_ms,d.status FROM dictionary_audio_asset a JOIN dictionary_audio_dataset d ON d.id=a.dataset_id WHERE a.id=#{id} AND d.status='READY'
mapper.update: UPDATE dictionary_audio_active SET dataset_id=#{dataset},version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE slot=1 AND version=#{version}
